## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `PrebuiltIntegrations`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `prebuilt-integrations`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **PrebuiltIntegrations**.

## Step 2: Go to the project-level view

1. Select **Explore more prebuilt integrations** to see the full catalog.

## Step 3: Pick the first application

1. <!-- manual: Choose the application you want to integrate from. -->

## Step 4: Pick the second application

1. Select **Google Sheets**.

## Step 5: Choose an integration scenario

1. Select **Export Salesforce Leads to a Google Sheet** integration.
2. Select **Configure & Deploy** to continue.

## Step 6: Review the setup instructions and configure credentials

1. Fill in your credentials and configuration, then select **Deploy**.
2. <!-- manual: Fill in your credentials and configuration, then select Deploy. -->

## Step 7: Test it

1. Select **Test** on the **Development** environment to trigger an execution.
2. Wait 8 seconds.

## Step 8: Make it yours

1. Select **Open in Cloud** to edit the integration in low-code or pro-code view, right in the cloud editor.
2. <!-- manual: Edit however you're most comfortable, then push the result to your own repository. -->
